questions.question: The number of students in two sections A and B having different heights is shown in the table given below: Height (in metres) Section A Section B 1.55 5 4 1.60 9 8 1.62 11 13 1.65 14 10 1.68 6 7 1.71 7 5 1.75 4 3 What is the ratio of the total number of students in Section A whose height is less than 1.65 metres to the total number of students in Section B whose height is less than 1.65 metres?
questions.questionHtml:
The number of students in two sections A and B having different heights is shown in the table given below:

Height (in metres) Section A Section B
1.55 5 4
1.60 9 8
1.62 11 13
1.65 14 10
1.68 6 7
1.71 7 5
1.75 4 3
What is the ratio of the total number of students in Section A whose height is less than 1.65 metres to the total number of students in Section B whose height is less than 1.65 metres?
questions.solution:
Section A total below 1.65 m ⇒ 5 + 9 + 11 = 25

Section B total below 1.65 m ⇒ 4 + 8 + 13 = 25

Required ratio ⇒ 25 : 25 = 1 : 1

questions.question: A and B invest ₹60,000 and ₹90,000 respectively, in a business. After one year, the profit is distributed, including simple interest at 10% per annum on the capital. Total profit, including interest, is ₹25,000. What is A's share?
questions.questionHtml: A and B invest ₹60,000 and ₹90,000 respectively, in a business. After one year, the profit is distributed, including simple interest at 10% per annum on the capital. Total profit, including interest, is ₹25,000. What is A's share?
questions.solution:
⇒ Interest of A = 60,000 × 10 ÷ 100 = 6,000

⇒ Interest of B = 90,000 × 10 ÷ 100 = 9,000

⇒ Total interest = 6,000 + 9,000 = 15,000

⇒ Remaining profit = 25,000 − 15,000 = 10,000

⇒ Ratio of capitals = 60,000 : 90,000 = 2 : 3

⇒ A's share from remaining profit = 10,000 × 2 ÷ 5 = 4,000

⇒ Total share of A = 6,000 + 4,000 = 10,000

questions.question: Table - Units Sold of 3 Products Product Jan Feb Mar A 100 120 110 B 90 85 95 C 150 160 155 Which product had the highest average units sold?
questions.questionHtml:
Table - Units Sold of 3 Products

Product Jan Feb Mar
A 100 120 110
B 90 85 95
C 150 160 155
 

Which product had the highest average units sold?
questions.solution:
Product A average = (100 + 120 + 110) ÷ 3

⇒ Product A average = 330 ÷ 3 = 110

Product B average = (90 + 85 + 95) ÷ 3

⇒ Product B average = 270 ÷ 3 = 90

Product C average = (150 + 160 + 155) ÷ 3

⇒ Product C average = 465 ÷ 3 = 155

∴ Product C had the highest average units sold.

questions.question: A school organized a field trip for 100 students and 10 chaperones. Each student was given a snack pack containing items equal to 15% of the total number of students. Each chaperone received a snack pack with items equal to 25% of the total number of students. How many snack items were distributed in total?
questions.questionHtml: A school organized a field trip for 100 students and 10 chaperones. Each student was given a snack pack containing items equal to 15% of the total number of students. Each chaperone received a snack pack with items equal to 25% of the total number of students. How many snack items were distributed in total?
questions.solution:
⇒ Items per student = (15 ÷ 100) × 100 = 15

⇒ Total items to students = 15 × 100 = 1500

⇒ Items per chaperone = (25 ÷ 100) × 100 = 25

⇒ Total items to chaperones = 25 × 10 = 250

⇒ Total snack items distributed = 1500 + 250 = 1750

questions.question: One type of pulses is sold for ₹72 per kg at a 20% profit. Another type is sold for ₹60 per kg at a 25% profit. If these two varieties are mixed in the ratio of 2:1 (first variety to second variety) and the mixture is sold at ₹70 per kg, what is the overall profit or loss percentage?
questions.questionHtml: One type of pulses is sold for ₹72 per kg at a 20% profit. Another type is sold for ₹60 per kg at a 25% profit. If these two varieties are mixed in the ratio of 2:1 (first variety to second variety) and the mixture is sold at ₹70 per kg, what is the overall profit or loss percentage?
questions.solution:
<svg width="500" height="320" viewBox="0 0 500 320" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" style="display:block;margin:1px;background:#ffffff;border-radius:8px;border:1px solid #cccccc;box-sizing:border-box;">
  <defs>
    <marker id="arr" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="9" refY="5" markerWidth="6" markerHeight="6" orient="auto-start-reverse">
      <path d="M0,0 L10,5 L0,10 z" fill="#2255cc"/>
    </marker>
    <marker id="arrG" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="9" refY="5" markerWidth="6" markerHeight="6" orient="auto-start-reverse">
      <path d="M0,0 L10,5 L0,10 z" fill="#007700"/>
    </marker>
  </defs>

  <!-- ZONE 1: Mixing Mechanism -->
  <!-- Variety 1 Sacks (Ratio 2) -->
  <path d="M60,40 Q80,35 100,40 L110,90 Q80,100 50,90 Z" fill="#ddeeff" stroke="#2255cc" stroke-width="2"/>
  <text x="52" y="75" font-family="Arial" font-size="14" fill="#2255cc">CP: ₹60</text>
  <path d="M120,40 Q140,35 160,40 L170,90 Q140,100 110,90 Z" fill="#ddeeff" stroke="#2255cc" stroke-width="2"/>
  <text x="112" y="75" font-family="Arial" font-size="14" fill="#2255cc">CP: ₹60</text>
  <text x="85" y="115" font-family="Arial" font-size="14" fill="#222222" font-weight="700">Variety 1 (Ratio 2)</text>

  <!-- Variety 2 Sack (Ratio 1) -->
  <path d="M300,40 Q320,35 340,40 L350,90 Q320,100 290,90 Z" fill="#ede7f6" stroke="#6a1b9a" stroke-width="2"/>
  <text x="292" y="75" font-family="Arial" font-size="14" fill="#6a1b9a">CP: ₹48</text>
  <text x="275" y="115" font-family="Arial" font-size="14" fill="#222222" font-weight="700">Variety 2 (Ratio 1)</text>

  <!-- Mixing Bowl -->
  <path d="M100,160 Q225,200 350,160 L320,210 Q225,230 130,210 Z" fill="#f0f0f0" stroke="#555555" stroke-width="2"/>
  <line x1="110" y1="120" x2="160" y2="160" stroke="#555555" stroke-width="1.5" marker-end="url(#arr)"/>
  <line x1="320" y1="120" x2="280" y2="160" stroke="#555555" stroke-width="1.5" marker-end="url(#arr)"/>
  <text x="165" y="195" font-family="Arial" font-size="14" fill="#555555" font-weight="700">Mixture CP: ₹56</text>

  <!-- Profit Leap -->
  <path d="M360,190 Q430,190 430,150" fill="none" stroke="#007700" stroke-width="2" stroke-dasharray="4,2" marker-end="url(#arrG)"/>
  <text x="385" y="140" font-family="Arial" font-size="14" fill="#007700" font-weight="700">Mix SP: ₹70</text>
  <text x="435" y="165" font-family="Arial" font-size="14" fill="#007700" font-weight="700">+25%</text>

  <!-- ZONE 2: Solution -->
  <text x="30" y="245" font-family="Arial" font-size="14" fill="#222222">⇒ CP₁ = 72 ÷ 1.20 = 60; CP₂ = 60 ÷ 1.25 = 48</text>
  <text x="30" y="270" font-family="Arial" font-size="14" fill="#222222">⇒ Mixture CP = (60 × 2 + 48 × 1) ÷ 3 = 56</text>
  <text x="30" y="295" font-family="Arial" font-size="14" fill="#222222">⇒ Profit % = (70 − 56) ÷ 56 × 100</text>
  <text x="30" y="318" font-family="Arial" font-size="14" font-weight="700" fill="#000000">∴ Answer = Profit of 25%</text>
</svg>

questions.question: A wholesaler marks up the price of a microwave oven by 60% above its cost price. He gives a 15% trade discount to a retailer. The retailer, in turn, marks up the price by 25% above his purchase price and offers a 10% festival discount to the customer. If the customer finally pays ₹14,490 for the microwave, what is the original approximate cost price of the oven to the wholesaler?

questions.question: A can do a work in 8 days and B in 12 days. They work together for 3 days. What part of the work is left?
questions.questionHtml: A can do a work in 8 days and B in 12 days. They work together for 3 days. What part of the work is left?
questions.solution:
⇒ LCM of 8 and 12 = 24; Total Work = 24 units

⇒ Work done by A in 1 day = 24 ÷ 8 = 3 units; Work done by B in 1 day = 24 ÷ 12 = 2 units

⇒ Work done in 3 days = (3 + 2) × 3 = 15 units; Work left = 24 − 15 = 9 units

⇒ Part of work left = 9 ÷ 24 = 3 ÷ 8

questions.question: A and B can complete a task together in 12 days, while B and C can finish it in 16 days. After A works on it for 5 days and B for 7 days, C takes the remaining 13 days to finish the work. How many days would it take for C to complete the work alone?
questions.questionHtml: A and B can complete a task together in 12 days, while B and C can finish it in 16 days. After A works on it for 5 days and B for 7 days, C takes the remaining 13 days to finish the work. How many days would it take for C to complete the work alone?
questions.solution:
<svg width="480" height="290" viewBox="0 0 480 290" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" style="display:block;margin:1px;background:#ffffff;border-radius:8px;border:1px solid #cccccc;box-sizing:border-box;">
  <defs>
    <marker id="arr" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="9" refY="5" markerWidth="6" markerHeight="6" orient="auto-start-reverse"><path d="M0,0 L10,5 L0,10 z" fill="#2255cc"/></marker>
    <marker id="arrG" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="9" refY="5" markerWidth="6" markerHeight="6" orient="auto-start-reverse"><path d="M0,0 L10,5 L0,10 z" fill="#007700"/></marker>
    <marker id="arrO" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="9" refY="5" markerWidth="6" markerHeight="6" orient="auto-start-reverse"><path d="M0,0 L10,5 L0,10 z" fill="#cc5500"/></marker>
  </defs>

  <!-- ZONE 1: WORK TANK DIAGRAM -->
  <text x="240" y="25" font-family="Arial" font-size="14" fill="#555555" text-anchor="middle" font-weight="700">Total Work = 48 Units (LCM of 12, 16)</text>
  
  <!-- Tank Frame -->
  <rect x="40" y="40" width="400" height="100" fill="none" stroke="#555555" stroke-width="2.5" rx="5"/>
  
  <!-- Work Segments -->
  <rect x="40" y="40" width="166.7" height="100" fill="#ddeeff" stroke="#2255cc" stroke-width="1"/>
  <rect x="206.7" y="40" width="50" height="100" fill="#ccffcc" stroke="#007700" stroke-width="1"/>
  <rect x="256.7" y="40" width="183.3" height="100" fill="#fff0cc" stroke="#cc5500" stroke-width="1"/>
  
  <!-- Wavy top for water visual -->
  <path d="M 40 40 Q 60 30 80 40 T 120 40 T 160 40 T 200 40 T 240 40 T 280 40 T 320 40 T 360 40 T 400 40 T 440 40" fill="none" stroke="#555555" stroke-width="1.5"/>

  <!-- Labels for segments -->
  <text x="123" y="85" font-family="Arial" font-size="14" fill="#2255cc" text-anchor="middle">5 × (A+B)</text>
  <text x="123" y="105" font-family="Arial" font-size="12" fill="#2255cc" text-anchor="middle">(20 units)</text>
  
  <text x="231.7" y="85" font-family="Arial" font-size="14" fill="#007700" text-anchor="middle">2 × (B+C)</text>
  <text x="231.7" y="105" font-family="Arial" font-size="12" fill="#007700" text-anchor="middle">(6 u)</text>
  
  <text x="348.3" y="85" font-family="Arial" font-size="14" fill="#cc5500" text-anchor="middle">11 × C</text>
  <text x="348.3" y="105" font-family="Arial" font-size="12" fill="#cc5500" text-anchor="middle">(22 units)</text>

  <!-- Brackets/Spans -->
  <path d="M 40 145 L 40 152 L 206.7 152 L 206.7 145" fill="none" stroke="#2255cc" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <text x="123" y="168" font-family="Arial" font-size="12" fill="#2255cc" text-anchor="middle">A: 5d + B: 5d</text>
  
  <path d="M 206.7 145 L 206.7 152 L 256.7 152 L 256.7 145" fill="none" stroke="#007700" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <text x="231.7" y="168" font-family="Arial" font-size="12" fill="#007700" text-anchor="middle">B: 2d + C: 2d</text>

  <path d="M 256.7 145 L 256.7 152 L 440 152 L 440 145" fill="none" stroke="#cc5500" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <text x="348.3" y="168" font-family="Arial" font-size="12" fill="#cc5500" text-anchor="middle">C: Remaining 11d</text>

  <!-- ZONE 2: CALCULATION -->
  <text x="30" y="200" font-family="Arial" font-size="14" fill="#222222">⇒ Total Work = 48; Eff(A+B) = 4, Eff(B+C) = 3</text>
  <text x="30" y="225" font-family="Arial" font-size="14" fill="#222222">⇒ Work done: 20 + 6 + 11C = 48 ⇒ 11C = 22 units</text>
  <text x="30" y="250" font-family="Arial" font-size="14" fill="#222222">⇒ Eff(C) = 2 units/day ⇒ Time = 48 ÷ 2</text>
  
  <text x="30" y="280" font-family="Arial" font-size="14" font-weight="700" fill="#000000">∴ Answer = 24 days</text>
</svg>

questions.question: A cyclist travels from City A to City B at an average speed of 20 km/h and takes 4 hours. If they want to complete the same journey in 2.5 hours, by what amount (in km/h) should they increase their average speed?
questions.questionHtml: A cyclist travels from City A to City B at an average speed of 20 km/h and takes 4 hours. If they want to complete the same journey in 2.5 hours, by what amount (in km/h) should they increase their average speed?
questions.solution:
<svg width="500" height="240" viewBox="0 0 500 240" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" style="display:block;margin:1px;padding:0;background:#ffffff;border-radius:8px;border:1px solid #cccccc;box-sizing:border-box;">
  <defs>
    <marker id="arr" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="9" refY="5" markerWidth="6" markerHeight="6" orient="auto-start-reverse">

      <path d="M0,0 L10,5 L0,10 z" fill="#cc5500"/>
    </marker>
  </defs>

  <!-- ZONE 1: SPEED-DISTANCE MECHANISM -->
  <!-- Road -->
  <rect x="20" y="100" width="460" height="14" rx="7" fill="#f0f0f0" stroke="#555555" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <line x1="30" y1="107" x2="470" y2="107" stroke="#888888" stroke-dasharray="8,6" stroke-width="1"/>

  <circle cx="40" cy="107" r="4" fill="#555555"/>

    <circle cx="55" cy="30" r="10" stroke="#2255cc" stroke-width="2.5" fill="none"/>
    <path d="M20 30 L35 30 L50 10 L30 10 Z M35 30 L35 10 M50 10 L55 5" stroke="#2255cc" stroke-width="2.5" fill="none"/>

  <path d="M120 75 L440 75" stroke="#2255cc" stroke-width="2" marker-end="url(#arr)" stroke-dasharray="4,2"/>
  <text x="130" y="65" font-family="Arial" font-size="14" fill="#2255cc">Case 1: 20 km/h (4h)</text>
  
  <path d="M120 92 L440 92" stroke="#cc5500" stroke-width="2" marker-end="url(#arrO)"/>

  <path d="M40 140 Q250 160 460 140" fill="none" stroke="#888888" stroke-width="1"/>

questions.question: A train leaves Station A at 6:00 AM and travels towards Station B at a constant speed of 60 km/h. Another train leaves Station B at 8:00 AM and travels towards Station A at a constant speed of 90 km/h. The distance between the two stations is 540 km. At what time will the two trains meet?
questions.questionHtml: A train leaves Station A at 6:00 AM and travels towards Station B at a constant speed of 60 km/h. Another train leaves Station B at 8:00 AM and travels towards Station A at a constant speed of 90 km/h. The distance between the two stations is 540 km. At what time will the two trains meet?
questions.solution:
<svg width="550" height="280" viewBox="0 0 550 280" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" style="display:block;margin:1px;padding:0;background:#ffffff;border-radius:8px;border:1px solid #cccccc;box-sizing:border-box;">
  <defs>
    <marker id="arr" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="9" refY="5" markerWidth="6" markerHeight="6" orient="auto-start-reverse"><path d="M0,0 L10,5 L0,10 z" fill="#2255cc"/></marker>
    <marker id="arrO" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="9" refY="5" markerWidth="6" markerHeight="6" orient="auto-start-reverse"><path d="M0,0 L10,5 L0,10 z" fill="#cc5500"/></marker>
  </defs>

  <!-- Station Labels -->
  <text x="30" y="35" font-family="Arial" font-size="14" fill="#555555" font-weight="700">Station A</text>
  <text x="470" y="35" font-family="Arial" font-size="14" fill="#555555" font-weight="700">Station B</text>

  <!-- Track -->
  <rect x="40" y="100" width="460" height="4" fill="#f0f0f0" />
  <line x1="40" y1="102" x2="500" y2="102" stroke="#888888" stroke-dasharray="8,4" stroke-width="2"/>

  <!-- Train A at 6 AM -->
  <g transform="translate(40, 75)">
    <rect x="0" y="0" width="60" height="22" rx="4" fill="#ddeeff" stroke="#2255cc" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <rect x="8" y="5" width="8" height="8" fill="#ffffff" />
    <rect x="22" y="5" width="8" height="8" fill="#ffffff" />
    <rect x="36" y="5" width="8" height="8" fill="#ffffff" />
    <circle cx="15" cy="22" r="4" fill="#555555"/>
    <circle cx="45" cy="22" r="4" fill="#555555"/>
    <text x="0" y="-12" font-family="Arial" font-size="12" fill="#2255cc">6:00 AM (60 km/h)</text>
    <line x1="65" y1="11" x2="100" y2="11" stroke="#2255cc" stroke-width="2" marker-end="url(#arr)"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Train B at 8 AM -->
  <g transform="translate(440, 75)">
    <rect x="0" y="0" width="60" height="22" rx="4" fill="#fff0cc" stroke="#cc5500" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <rect x="8" y="5" width="8" height="8" fill="#ffffff" />
    <rect x="22" y="5" width="8" height="8" fill="#ffffff" />
    <rect x="36" y="5" width="8" height="8" fill="#ffffff" />
    <circle cx="15" cy="22" r="4" fill="#555555"/>
    <circle cx="45" cy="22" r="4" fill="#555555"/>
    <text x="-40" y="-12" font-family="Arial" font-size="12" fill="#cc5500">8:00 AM (90 km/h)</text>
    <line x1="-5" y1="11" x2="-40" y2="11" stroke="#cc5500" stroke-width="2" marker-end="url(#arrO)"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Train A position at 8 AM -->
  <g transform="translate(142, 75)" opacity="0.6">
    <rect x="0" y="0" width="60" height="22" rx="4" fill="#ddeeff" stroke="#2255cc" stroke-dasharray="3,2"/>
    <text x="0" y="-12" font-family="Arial" font-size="11" fill="#2255cc">8:00 AM</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Distance Braces -->
  <path d="M 40 135 L 40 145 L 142 145 L 142 135" fill="none" stroke="#2255cc" stroke-width="1"/>
  <text x="65" y="160" font-family="Arial" font-size="12" fill="#2255cc">120 km</text>

  <path d="M 142 135 L 142 145 L 500 145 L 500 135" fill="none" stroke="#6a1b9a" stroke-width="1"/>
  <text x="280" y="160" font-family="Arial" font-size="12" fill="#6a1b9a">Rel. Gap = 420 km</text>

  <path d="M 40 15 L 40 5 L 500 5 L 500 15" fill="none" stroke="#555555" stroke-width="1"/>
  <text x="240" y="20" font-family="Arial" font-size="12" fill="#555555">Total Distance = 540 km</text>

  <!-- Calculations Zone -->
  <text x="30" y="195" font-family="Arial" font-size="14" fill="#222222">⇒ Gap at 8 AM = 540 − (60 × 2) = 420 km</text>
  <text x="30" y="220" font-family="Arial" font-size="14" fill="#222222">⇒ Meeting Time = 8 AM + [420 ÷ (60 + 90)] = 8 AM + 2.8 hrs</text>
  <text x="30" y="245" font-family="Arial" font-size="14" fill="#222222">⇒ 2.8 hrs = 2 hours 48 minutes</text>

  <text x="30" y="272" font-family="Arial" font-size="14" font-weight="700" fill="#000000">∴ Answer = 10:48 AM</text>
</svg>

questions.question: A circular garden having a diameter of 10 m is surrounded by a concrete path that is 1 m wide. Calculate the percentage increase in area resulting from the addition of the path.
questions.questionHtml: A circular garden having a diameter of 10 m is surrounded by a concrete path that is 1 m wide. Calculate the percentage increase in area resulting from the addition of the path.
questions.solution:
Original area ⇒ π × 52 = 25π

New area ⇒ π × 62 = 36π

Percentage increase ⇒ [(36π − 25π) ÷ 25π] × 100 = (11 ÷ 25) × 100 = 44%

questions.question: A circular signboard has a radius of 2 m. If painting costs ₹60 per m² and 10% of the board is left unpainted, what is the total painting cost?
questions.questionHtml: A circular signboard has a radius of 2 m. If painting costs ₹60 per m² and 10% of the board is left unpainted, what is the total painting cost?
questions.solution:
Total area = π × r2 = π × 22 = 4π ≈ 12.56 m2

Painted area = Total area × (90 ÷ 100) = 12.56 × 0.9 = 11.304 m2

Total painting cost = Painted area × ₹60 = 11.304 × 60 = ₹678.2
